metadata.title: Microsoft AI Brand Image Reference Library
metadata.description: Curated collection of images embodying the MAI visual language

categories.name: Abstract & Artistic

categories.name: Illustrated Cityscapes

categories.name: Gradients

images.title: Abstract Landscape Triptych
images.description: A triptych of three abstract landscape paintings featuring painterly brushstrokes. Left panel shows a dramatic sunset with orange and coral clouds over teal water. Center panel depicts rolling green hills under a pale sky. Right panel shows a dark moody landscape with magenta accents on the horizon.

images.title: Nature Photography Mood Board
images.description: A curated mood board layout on a beige/cream background with scattered photo cards. Features nature and lifestyle imagery including: a crocodile in water with lily pads, a windswept grass field at sunset, mountain sunrise with rural road, a lone tree silhouette at sunset, gourmet open-faced sandwiches, ocean sunset, and a citrus cross-section. Subtle pencil sketch lines add an artistic touch.

images.title: Abstract Wave Data Visualization
images.description: A minimalist black and white artistic data visualization featuring sinusoidal wave patterns with ink splatter effects. Multiple overlapping curves create depth, with scattered dots and vertical lines suggesting data points or musical notation. The composition evokes scientific graphs merged with abstract expressionism.

images.title: Ancient Smiling Stone Face
images.description: A carved stone sculpture resembling an ancient artifact with a simple, friendly smiling face. The oval-shaped gray stone features minimal carved features - two curved eyes and a wide smile - evoking prehistoric or indigenous art styles. The warm, approachable expression suggests AI personality and accessibility.

images.title: Retro Tech Object Collection
images.description: A flat-lay composition on black background featuring vintage and modern technology objects. Includes: retro CRT computer monitor, vintage typewriter, mushrooms, classic car detail, CPU/microprocessor chip, circuit boards, microscope, ceramic vase, and various tech components. The juxtaposition of organic (mushrooms) with mechanical creates an interesting contrast.

images.title: Impressionist Summer Scene
images.description: A vibrant impressionist-style illustration of a Mediterranean summer scene. Features people swimming in a winding river or pool, cyclists on a path, lush green foliage, cypress trees, and purple mountains in the background. The loose, expressive brushwork and warm color palette evoke leisure and joy.

images.title: White Daisies Against Blue Sky
images.description: A serene nature photograph featuring white daisy flowers with yellow centers against a soft, gradient blue sky background. The shallow depth of field creates a dreamy bokeh effect with some flowers in sharp focus while others blur softly. Conveys simplicity, calm, and natural beauty.

images.title: Human Eye Close-Up
images.description: An extreme macro close-up video of a human eye with blue-gray iris and auburn/red hair visible at the edges. The video captures subtle natural movements including blinking. The intimate, cinematic footage emphasizes human connection, warmth, and the beauty of natural details. Soft, warm lighting highlights skin texture and the intricate details of the iris and eyelashes.

images.title: Copilot Sessions Meeting Pod
images.description: A modern meeting pod booth at a Microsoft event, featuring two people having a casual conversation at a small round table. The glass-walled pod displays 'Copilot Sessions' and 'Release' branding with artwork including the friendly MAI mascot. Surrounded by indoor plants and natural light, creating an inviting, collaborative atmosphere.

images.title: Redmond Park Scene
images.description: A loose, sketch-style watercolor illustration of a Redmond park scene with Mt. Hood visible in the background. People relax on green lawns with deck chairs, surrounded by tall evergreen trees and urban buildings. Bright, cheerful palette with blue sky and white clouds.

images.title: New York Times Square
images.description: A vibrant, loose watercolor illustration of Times Square in New York City. Features iconic billboards, yellow taxis, bustling pedestrians, and urban energy. Expressive brushstrokes capture the chaos and excitement of the iconic intersection with warm and cool color contrasts.

images.title: Lisbon/Istanbul Bosphorus Bridge
images.description: A colorful watercolor cityscape showing a coastal city with a prominent suspension bridge (resembling the Bosphorus or 25 de Abril bridge). Features terracotta-roofed buildings cascading down hillsides, blue water with sailboats, and a bright Mediterranean atmosphere.

images.title: Beijing Cityscape
images.description: An illustrated Beijing cityscape blending traditional Chinese architecture (pagoda-style temple) with modern skyscrapers. Features the CCTV tower, busy streets with traffic, and lush green parks. Warm color palette with reds and greens capturing the city's cultural fusion.

images.title: London Street Scene
images.description: A charming watercolor illustration of a London street scene featuring a classic red double-decker bus, a green newsstand kiosk, and outdoor cafe seating. Georgian architecture and tree-lined streets create a quintessentially British atmosphere with warm, inviting colors.

images.title: Suzhou Water Canal
images.description: A delicate watercolor of Suzhou's famous water canals with traditional boats, weeping willow trees, and historic waterside buildings with red-tiled roofs. The floating, unfinished edges give an ethereal quality. Soft pastels and blues evoke the tranquil 'Venice of the East.'

images.title: Hyderabad Cityscape
images.description: A warm-toned watercolor illustration of Hyderabad, India featuring modern high-rise buildings, palm trees, and tropical vegetation. The cityscape has a sunny, vibrant feel with turquoise and coral accents against a blue sky with stars suggesting evening.

images.title: Zurich Old Town
images.description: A charming watercolor illustration of Zurich's old town featuring the distinctive Grossmünster church spire, colorful historic buildings with orange and coral rooftops, and European street life. Soft, warm palette captures the Swiss city's blend of medieval and modern character.

images.title: Woman with Phone Smiling
images.description: A candid portrait of a young woman with wavy brown hair, smiling warmly while holding a phone. Wearing a black top in a modern office environment with plants visible. The warm, low-light setting creates an intimate, approachable feel.

images.title: Man Against Sky Background
images.description: A professional headshot of a man with strawberry blonde hair wearing a dark navy sweater, photographed against a soft blue sky background. Natural lighting, slight smile, looking off-camera. Clean, minimalist corporate portrait style.

images.title: Woman with Autumn Leaves
images.description: A playful portrait of a woman in a yellow jacket holding autumn leaves over her eyes, smiling broadly. Outdoor setting with green foliage and stairs in background. Captures joy, playfulness, and connection with nature in warm autumn tones.

images.title: Woman at Event with Coffee
images.description: A candid photo of an Asian woman at an indoor event, holding a coffee cup and smiling while looking to the side. Wearing a gray sweater in warm ambient lighting. Captures a genuine moment of engagement and warmth at a professional gathering.

images.title: Woman by Window Smiling
images.description: A natural portrait of an Asian woman with long dark hair in a ponytail, wearing a dark patterned top. Photographed near a window with soft natural light, looking off-camera with a warm smile. Professional yet relaxed atmosphere.

images.title: Woman Laughing at Conference
images.description: A dynamic candid shot of a blonde woman laughing heartily at a conference or professional event. Wearing a black top with a lanyard badge, with visible arm tattoo. Background shows other attendees, capturing genuine joy and connection at a workplace gathering.

images.title: Woman Speaker with Microphone
images.description: A confident portrait of a woman with long dark wavy hair holding a microphone at an event. Wearing a navy blue dress with a conference lanyard, soft smile, against a light background. Professional speaker or presenter presence.

images.title: Young Man Outdoor Portrait
images.description: A bright, friendly portrait of a young South Asian man with glasses, smiling warmly in an outdoor garden setting. Wearing a sage green button-up shirt with lush green foliage and flowers in the soft-focus background. Natural, approachable headshot style.

images.title: Man Seated Casual Portrait
images.description: A casual portrait of a bearded man with a warm smile, seated on a green chair wearing a burgundy sweater and jeans. Minimal background, relaxed posture. The image has a vintage film quality with warm tones and genuine expression.

images.title: Man in Blue Shirt Headshot
images.description: A professional headshot of a young man with dark hair wearing a light blue oxford shirt, smiling naturally against a soft green bokeh background. Dappled sunlight creates a warm, outdoor feel. Clean, polished corporate portrait.

images.title: Woman with Camera Winter Portrait
images.description: An environmental portrait of a woman in a brown wool coat holding a camera, standing in a winter landscape with patchy snow and a water tower in the background. Film photography aesthetic with muted, nostalgic colors. Captures creativity and outdoor exploration.

images.title: Man in Black T-Shirt Portrait
images.description: A relaxed portrait of a man with curly dark hair wearing a black t-shirt, photographed against soft white curtains. Natural smile, looking slightly off-camera. Warm, intimate feel with soft diffused lighting. Approachable, casual style.

images.title: Man in Purple Shirt Outdoor
images.description: A professional outdoor portrait of a man in a purple/blue patterned shirt with a dark jacket, wearing a gold necklace. Smiling warmly with hand near his ear in a natural pose. Modern glass building reflections in background create depth.

images.title: Woman in Red Cardigan
images.description: A striking portrait of a woman with curly highlighted hair and large black glasses, wearing a bright red cardigan over black. Photographed from a low angle against a pale blue sky, looking upward with a confident, joyful smile.

images.title: Person Presenting with MAI Lanyard
images.description: A candid portrait of a person with short dark hair and round glasses, gesturing while speaking at what appears to be a Microsoft AI event. Wearing a blue denim shirt with an 'MAI' branded lanyard. Captures active engagement and communication.

images.title: Man with Glasses Green Shirt
images.description: A thoughtful professional portrait of a man with glasses wearing an emerald green mandarin-collar shirt. Photographed in soft window light with a blurred indoor background. Composed, intelligent expression with a slight contemplative look.

images.title: Person Jumping into Lake
images.description: An action shot capturing a person mid-jump from a dock into a calm lake surrounded by forested hills. Arms raised in joy, captured from behind. Blue sky with fluffy clouds, summer vibes. Evokes freedom, spontaneity, and outdoor adventure.

images.title: Man on Terracotta Background
images.description: A warm studio portrait of a bearded man with dark hair, smiling genuinely, wearing an olive/brown corduroy jacket over a dark shirt. Shot against a rich terracotta/burnt orange backdrop. Warm, earthy tones create an inviting, approachable feel.

images.title: Woman in Olive Turtleneck
images.description: A polished portrait of a woman with long brown hair wearing an olive green ribbed turtleneck sweater with a delicate gold necklace. Soft sage/mint background, looking slightly off-camera with a subtle, confident expression. Clean, modern aesthetic.

images.title: Woman at Museum Event
images.description: A candid portrait of a woman with long dark hair laughing at what appears to be a museum or aviation-themed venue. Wearing a leopard print jacket with leather collar, holding a drink. Purple ambient lighting, vintage aircraft visible in background.

images.title: Orange Gradient Background
images.description: A smooth, warm gradient background transitioning through shades of orange, from peachy coral to deeper burnt orange tones. Soft, organic flow with subtle variations. Ideal for backgrounds, overlays, or brand materials requiring warm, inviting tones.
